limits: The persistent service has configurable per-attempt deadlines and retry cap. MaxFailures0 explicitly permits unlimited consecutive transient retries with bounded live resources. Shared Closed observers do not cancel maintenance; Close is explicit.
One native generation/candidate and one native control Future;3 embedded Watch slots,1 controller timer and1 coalesced post. Existing native transport/request resources keep their own bounds.

Live deltas inspect at most1024 merge entries and one batch per turn. Unchanged entries share identity and avoid payload comparison; removals precede additions. Finish the captured snapshot then follow newer desired state without reconnecting solely for edits.
Native receive is direct: no per-message controller code, copy, proxy queue or callback is added. Retained old native generations and snapshots own their queued/pinned data as caller results.

Closed publishes after native generation/Store/context access retirement and Drop/Engine unpin. Final post/Watch reference-release frames can finish later without context/Engine access; quota-zero tests join worker turns.
Ordinary commands are never automatically replayed. Restoring Pub/Sub names cannot recover missed messages; delivery remains at-most-once.
Sentinel/Cluster endpoint selection and MOVED handling, blocking-lane product policy and remaining four-library scope are not claimed complete.

Performance includes queue/wait and configured1ms retry in each single-operation sample. Polling observers and whole-loopback fixture heap/ring/retained close metadata are included. Initial setup release frames are not explicitly joined before timing.
All raw samples and noise gates remain; only jointly passing unchanged3% MAD/6% central-span qualify5% throughput/10% P99 budgets. No conclusion follows from unqualified raw medians.
CPU/RSS, pinned/upstream/fixed-arrival mixed loads, native Linux hosts and>=72h production acceptance remain open. Windows/WSL and sanitizers do not prove those gates.
